To create the API token, enter the 'Logi: To create the API token, enter the 'Login' and 'Pass' values from the sticker or information sheet of the gateway (firmware 15.00.01 or newer is required). Then press the WLAN and Wireless buttons on the gateway at the same time for one second and click 'Request API token' within 5 minutes. The token appears in the field above, then save the settings. Login and Pass are not stored. The token does not expire, so treat it like a password. The manufacturer's guide explains the steps:

The diagnosis report is a short text for: The diagnosis report is a short text for forum posts. It contains the adapter version, a few device properties, the paths that have no readable name yet and the fixed values that have no text yet. It contains no measured values and no personal data such as the IP address or serial numbers. If you switch the option on, the adapter creates the data point info.diagnosis and keeps it up to date. If you switch it off, the data point is deleted. Saving the settings restarts the adapter.
To copy the report, open the object bosc: To copy the report, open the object bosch-buderus-wp.0.info.diagnosis in the Objects tab, click the value and copy the text. Please look through the report before you post it, and add your heat pump model to your post. Please post the report in a code block (button </> in the forum editor), so that the thread stays tidy.
The plant diagram shows the operating st: The plant diagram shows the operating state of the heat pump (heating, hot water, defrosting) and a few values. It is displayed by the web adapter, so a web adapter instance must be installed. If you switch the option on, the adapter creates the data point calculated.schema with the values for the diagram and keeps it up to date. If you switch it off, the data point is deleted. The page opens through the link "Plant diagram" in the instance list of the admin UI. Saving the settings restarts the adapter.
